info.name: Tasty Bites Restaurant API
info.description: Menu CRUD API. Base URL defaults to http://localhost:3000. Name: string, at least 3 characters. Description: string, at least 10 characters. Price: JSON number greater than 0. Category: appetizer, entree, dessert, or beverage. Ingredients: nonempty array of nonblank strings. Available: boolean, defaults to true. Errors share an error object with code and message. Validation errors include field details. This classroom API stores data in memory and resets when restarted.

response.name: Successful GET - Retrieve all menu items
response.body:
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Garden Pasta",
    "description": "Pasta with fresh vegetables and tomato sauce.",
    "price": 14.5,
    "category": "entree",
    "ingredients": [
      "pasta",
      "tomato",
      "zucchini"
    ],
    "available": true
  }
]

request.description: Returns a menu item by its numeric ID. A missing item returns 404.

response.name: Error 404 - Menu item not found

request.description: Creates a menu item. All fields except available are required. Available defaults to true.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Chocolate Cake",
  "description": "Chocolate cake served with vanilla cream.",
  "price": 7,
  "category": "dessert",
  "ingredients": [
    "cocoa",
    "flour",
    "cream"
  ],
  "available": true
}
